contact.address: 1814 E Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Austin, TX 78702

colour_palette.details: Natural earthy tones (warm green, sand, off-white) reflecting their bakery patio garden. Color implementation lacks consistent design tokens across sections.

logo.details: Charming custom hand-drawn duck illustration logo with organic character, though served as a raster graphic without SVG fallback.

typography.details: Mixed sans-serif body and casual serif headings with inconsistent line-heights and cramped letter-spacing on mobile.

contact.details: Prominent phone number, physical address, and general inquiry channels are listed clearly.

online_presence.details: Legacy template architecture with disjointed Toast Tab iframe/redirect ordering handoffs and incomplete schema.org metadata.

verdict.commercial_rationale: High-profile bakery, bar, and farm-to-table casual dining spot backed by the Odd Duck group. A unified web experience integrating their bakery pre-orders, daily specials, and market goods would streamline customer flow.

sample_website.notes: Farm-to-table bakery & beer garden marketplace concept.
